Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0

replacements.attribution_placement: In the TEXT of the YouTube description (in-video credit alone is not read by Content ID), before publishing. Trimming/splicing needs no extra mention (FAQ); if we add our own musical parts, say which parts are ours.
replacements.media_info: 195.3 s; mp3 44100 Hz stereo 256 kbps; integrated -16.7 LUFS, LRA 3.7 LU, true peak -0.5 dBTP; file(1): Audio file with ID3 version 2.2.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 256 kbps, 44.1 kHz,
replacements.match_quality: close: bright glockenspiel + flute/clarinet + strings, light and steady like Little Bells (LRA 3.7 vs 2.8 LU, centroid 795 vs 736 Hz, 2.7 vs 3.0 onsets/s); differs by a lilting 6/8 waltz feel instead of a straight minimalist pulse; mastered 8.7 dB quieter (-16.7 vs -8.0 LUFS)

feature_comparison.legend: centroid = median spectral centroid Hz; onsets_per_s = spectral-flux peaks per second; pulse = beat autocorrelation 0-1; low/high = share of spectrum <200 Hz / >4 kHz

replacements.use_cases: curious/light explainer bed, "did you know" setup, map zoom-ins; gentle bouncy waltz, duck under VO
replacements.content_id_note: Kevin MacLeod pre-registers his music in YouTube Content ID (incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/youtube-contentid.html, checked 2026-10-24) so that third parties cannot falsely register it. A claim appears when the credit is missing from the description text or is only in the video. Fix: add the credit to the description FIRST, then dispute; release within 72 h per the author; bulk release form and help@incompetech.com for persistent cases. A Short > 60 s with an active claim is blocked worldwide until released -> channel rule: MacLeod tracks only in Shorts <= 60 s, credit in description before publishing. Keep proof: ISRC, sha256, the saved FAQ / Content ID pages and the CC BY 4.0 legal code in 02_Research/download_logs/music_replacement_proof/.
